title: Midyear priority catalyst and all-hands ops - draft
body:
Purpose: quick operational playbook to align company OKRs for the remainder of the year, produce the exec update slide packet, and lock an all-hands run of show. This is a working doc — many TODOs, parking lot items, and short-hand notes below.

Key constraints
- must be concise: exec deck <= 10 slides, all-hands <= 60 minutes live + 15min buffer for overflow.
- align on three company-level priorities (see draft OKRs).
- ensure Dedicated sales commitments and Private onboarding are called out as enterprise asks.
- surface any capacity risk to SRE/infra (gpu pool, preemptible risk) ahead of rollouts.

Audience
- Execs + direct reports (finalize content with TLs)
- All-hands: whole company (primary focus: product/eng + CS + GTM updates)

Draft company-level OKRs (top-level, to be refined with product leads)
- Objective A: Make inference cost and latency predictable for customers so they can scale with confidence.
  - KR1: Reduce 95p latency for hosted API by 15% across top-5 endpoints (by model) — measurement: per-route latency dashboard.
  - KR2: Lower per-token serving cost for long-tail workloads by 10% via intelligent batching and prefix caching suggestions shipped in Optimize.
  - KR3: Ship documented fallback routing policy + 99.95% availability SLA for Dedicated customers in US region.

- Objective B: Grow enterprise adoption of Dedicated and Private offerings.
  - KR1: Close 3 new Dedicated contracts (>=$200k ARR annualized).
  - KR2: Complete 2 private deployments (VPC or on-prem) with audit logs + KMS integration.
  - KR3: Reduce time-to-onboard for Dedicated customers from contract to first production deploy < 8 weeks.

- Objective C: Developer-first experience — reduce cognitive overhead for ML engineers.
  - KR1: Launch SDK v2 with streaming and structured output ergonomics; reach 75% adoption for new projects.
  - KR2: Ship per-route cost/latency introspection in Console and instrument 5 pilot customers.
  - KR3: Publish 8 technical how-tos / quickstarts aimed at real production workloads.

Notes on KR sizing: These are intentionally directional. Product leads — make them measurable by 7/1. If a KR requires cross-team resource (SRE/infra, Optimize), flag as dependency.

Team-level asks (quick):
- Eng-serving-runtime: plan to freeze major kernel changes 2 weeks before all-hands. Provide short talk: "Runtime wins: 95p latency story" (10m + 5m demo). Owner: Diego.
- Product-hosted-api: finalize user-facing quota changes and migration notes. Provide 2 slide bullets. Owner: Rhea.
- GTM/Sales: provide topline pipeline update and 3 customer success stories (Dedicated wins). Owner: Ethan.
- Research/Applied ML: short note on model onboarding and quantization progress. Owner: Sohini.

All-hands draft run of show (target date: week of 7/21, tentative)
- 0:00–0:05 — Welcome + housekeeping (host: Maya)
  - pre-reads: 1-pager okrs + exec highlights posted 48h prior
- 0:05–0:20 — Exec update (CEO) — 10m slides + 5m rapid q&a (synchronous chat)
- 0:20–0:35 — Product & roadmap highlights (CPO / product host) — big bets and customer context
- 0:35–0:45 — Engineering highlight: runtime wins (Diego) — demo of batching improvement (live)
- 0:45–0:50 — Customer spotlight (GTM) — success story on Dedicated conversion
- 0:50–0:55 — People & org updates (People Ops) — headcount changes, new hires, offsites
- 0:55–1:00 — Closing + live pulse (slack emoji reaction + 3-word pulse)

Logistics checklist (ops)
- Slides: deadline 7/10 for first pass to execs.
- Exec review: 7/14 (30m) — coordinates with CEO/COO.
- All-hands rehearsal: 7/17 (30–45m) — run full sequence, test streaming.
- Recording + transcript: ensure captions + transcript posted to Drive within 24h.
- Survey: 24h post all-hands (3 quick qs) — owner: People Ops.

Communication plan
- 48h before: publish 1-pager OKRs + ask leads for 150–200 words describing impact.
- 24h before: agenda + reminder + quick FAQ doc.
- Day-of: publish TLDR (slide deck link) and Slack thread for questions.
- Post: publish recording + action items doc with owners and due dates.

Risk register (top of mind)
- Infra risk: limited Dedicated capacity in EMEA region — mitigation: enable US fallback + communicate to affected customers. Owner: SRE (Liam).
- Comm risk: too many deep technical slides — mitigation: keep 2 technical slides max; longer tech talks to follow-up office hours.
- Sales ask overload: GTM requests additional eng time to support pilots — mitigation: prioritize 3 highest impact pilots, defer rest.

Decision log (current)
- Decision 1 (tentative): All-hands will not include long-form product demos — separate office hours for demos. Rationale: time + attention. Owner: Maya.
- Decision 2 (tentative): Executive deck limited to 10 slides. Owner: CEO/Exec office.

Open issues / parking lot
- Q: Do we create a short public-facing blog on customer wins aligned to OKRs? (GTM)
- Q: Should we make one cross-functional KR explicitly about technical debt remediation?
- Action: Product leads to list 5 top customer-facing metrics they want included in exec update (due 7/3).

Draft exec update bullets (for slides)
- Market + traction: hosted usage up 28% YoY; Dedicated pipeline growing; newer markets seeing increased adoption (EMEA pilot).
- Platform health: latency improvements from batching shipped; incident count stable vs. last quarter; investigating 2 recurring capacity incidents.
- Customer wins: closed strategic conversion with AcmeCorp (Dedicated) — highlight cost/latency story.
- Risks + asks: need $X of upfront infra spend for EMEA capacity; request prioritized eng cycles for two Dedicated pilots.

Pre-reads (to assemble)
- 1-pager company okrs (this doc + cleaned version)
- pipeline summary (GTM dashboard link)
- infra capacity snapshot (SRE dashboard link)
- 3 customer case studies (CS short bullets + metrics)

Next steps (immediate owners)
- By 7/01: Product leads refine KRs; post to this doc (Owner: Rhea).
- By 7/03: GTM provides pipeline slide + 3 customer stories (Owner: Ethan).
- By 7/10: First-pass slides assembled and uploaded (Owner: Maya).
- By 7/14: Exec review + final edits (Owner: CEO office).
- By 7/17: All-hands rehearsal (Owner: Maya + SRE for streaming test).

Quick notes to collaborators
- Keep language non-technical in the exec slide set. Use appendix for deeper technical details (link appendix to Confluence).
- If you add content here, mark it with initials and date. Example: "[DM 2025-06-05] proposed KR change".
- Tag any cross-team blockers with JIRA ticket IDs so we can triage in ops review.

Parking-lot ideas for post-all-hands
- 60m office hours per product area to deep-dive on technical work.
- Cross-team hack day to address small infra debt items called out by SRE.
- Release a short community-facing whitepaper on "serving economics" (Marketing + Research).

Raw notes / brain-dump (messy)
- We should avoid too many metrics — pick 3-4 that tell a story.
- Consider a short customer video clip (30s) rather than slide text — higher impact.
- If Dedicated contracts need fast onboarding, prep a "kickoff pack" template: checklist, security preflight, RBAC notes.
- Need a clear owner for post-all-hands action tracking (Ops + People Ops).

If you have edits: add them inline with initials and date. Next sync: 7/01 10:00am PT (30m) to lock KRs and confirm owners.

— End of draft —

Document history: created 2025-06-02 (Maya), collaborators added 2025-06-05 through 2025-07-10.
